special_abilities.name: Graveyard Warding
special_abilities.desc: Can't pass a barrier or line of iron, such as a wrought-iron fence or iron filings; the barrier extends 1 mile up.

special_abilities.name: Variation

actions.name: Multiattack

special_abilities.name: Corpse Fuel

special_abilities.name: Fire Form

special_abilities.name: Illumination

special_abilities.name: Soul Burn

actions.desc: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 5 (2d4) Piercing, or 2 (1d4) while Bloodied; while not Bloodied, a creature it hits is Charmed until the start of the swarm's next turn.

reactions.desc: When a creature that gave it a delivery and is on the same plane uses an action to look through it, the swarm becomes a scrying sensor as if that creature cast Scrying, and the creature can speak through it.
